protocol.title: 突变与跨代稳定性
protocol.hypothesis: 过高的突变率会降低适应后的稳定性吗？
protocol.independent: 每个遗传参数的突变概率 0/0.04/0.2
protocol.dependent: 平均种群；后半段种群变异系数；感知范围方差；每创始个体后代数
protocol.confounds: 只运行有限代数；固定网络拓扑；自然选择通过能量繁殖实现，不含学习；种群上限可能截断优势。
protocol.limits: 感知范围方差仅是单一性状多样性代理；零效应不等于突变率永远无影响。

plan.statisticalUnit: independent world; paired arms by seed
plan.stoppingRule: fixed ticks/repeats; no optional stopping or tuning after results

contrasts.method: exact paired sign-flip + percentile paired bootstrap
exact paired sign-flip + percentile paired bootstrap

interpretation: Model-specific repeated-world comparison; CI is bootstrap uncertainty, pHolm controls planned contrasts within this experiment. Secondary metrics are descriptive.
